name: novel-workbench
description: The opened folder as a workspace of novels: universes, books, chapters and scenes in the explorer; characters, places and things as symbols with their records and every line that refers to them.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No books are known in this folder yet.
[Scan this folder](command:novel.scan)
The scan finds every EPUB and text file under the folder and keeps what it finds in a hidden .novel folder. Your files are never moved or changed.
Open a book that has a reading to see its people, places and things.

commands.title: Find Every Line That Refers to This

novel.serverPath.description: Path of the novel language server (dist/src/v3/server.js of the novel-ontology-pi repository). Empty: the one beside this extension.

novel.nodePath.description: A Node.js (22 or later) to run the language server with. Empty: the editor's own.

novel.scanOnOpen.description: Scan the opened folder when it holds an EPUB or was scanned before.
